__NOTOC__
<ic>To appoint an Imperial Citizen to the position of Ambassador to the Sarcophan Delves<br><i>Proposed by Necropolis. seconded by Reikos</i></ic> 

===Overview===
* This motion appoints someone to be responsible for the [[Embassy|Sarcophan Embassy]], and to represent the Empire in dealings with the Sarcophan Delves

===Date===
* Autumn 381YE

===Campaign Outcome===
* Thanmir Hrafnar was appointed as [[Ambassador to the Sarcophan Delves]]
